decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the established BASIC 518 trommel with a proven following, so its value is largely confirmed and keeping it costs little.
The mobile flail shredder line fits the core mobile business, and the lack of recent visibility is not yet clear enough evidence to abandon it.
The mobile grinder line belongs to the core portfolio, but its weak visibility leaves uncertainty, so the option stays open at low cost.
This single stationary fine shredder overlaps with other shredders and has the weakest evidence, making it the prime candidate for pruning, but abandonment is not yet clearly justified.
The green-waste grinder overlaps with Product C and may be consolidated, yet it still serves a distinct composting and biomass niche, so it is kept for now.
The stationary pre-shredder line supports plant solutions and had prominent presentation, though stationary products are less central and face some risk of portfolio streamlining.
